tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search Products
tools.description: Search Shoppable's product catalog by keyword, brand, or category. Returns a JSON payload with id, name, brand, category, price, salePrice, merchant, image, and a pre-built checkoutUrl for each result. Use the product ID with add_to_cart if you need to refresh the checkout URL later. SEARCH TIPS: the catalog is keyword-matched, so query with concise PRODUCT terms — the core product type plus distinguishing attributes (e.g. "oil-free sunscreen", not "a sunscreen that won't break me out"). Pass price limits via minPrice/maxPrice and a retailer via merchantId rather than putting them in the query text. Drop conversational filler; generic/non-product words (e.g. "good", "professional", "that won't") can surface irrelevant items like books or music whose titles happen to contain those words.

query.description: Search query — keywords, product name, brand, or category

merchantId.description: Filter results to a specific merchant MongoDB ID

dedupe.description: Collapse size/style variants so each distinct product appears once (default true)

sessionId.description: Shopping session id. OMIT on the first search; the response returns a sessionId — pass that SAME sessionId on every later search AND into add_to_cart / add_multiple_to_cart, so the shopper's searches and cart stay linked (this powers personalized recommendations on the checkout page).

total.description: Total products matching the query across all pages

count.description: Number of products returned in this page

id.description: Stable product id; pass to find_similar, or use a variation UPC with add_to_cart

checkoutUrl.description: Pre-built checkout URL for this product

size.description: Size of this specific item, if applicable

color.description: Color of this specific item, if applicable

upc.description: UPC to pass to add_to_cart for this variant

variations.description: Size/color variants of this product; each carries the UPC to add to cart

sessionId.description: Shopping session id — pass into later searches and add_to_cart to keep the shopper's activity linked

truncated.description: True if results were trimmed to fit the tool-result size limit

tools.name: get_merchant
tools.title: Get Merchant
tools.description: Look up a Shoppable merchant by name or ID. Returns merchant info including catalog size and network.

name.description: Partial merchant name to search for

found.description: Whether any matching merchant was found

id.description: Merchant MongoDB ID — pass as merchantId to other tools

network.description: Affiliate network the merchant belongs to

catalogSize.description: Number of products in the merchant catalog

isActive.description: Whether the merchant is currently active

merchants.description: Matching merchants (one entry for an exact id lookup, several for a name search)

message.description: Human-readable note, e.g. when nothing matched

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.title: Add to Cart
tools.description: Add a single product (by UPC) to a Shoppable cart. Returns sessionId, itemCount, and an updated checkoutUrl. IMPORTANT for multi-item carts: each call without a sessionId creates a NEW separate cart, so the shopper would have to check out multiple times. If you are adding more than one item in the same conversation: (1) preferred — use add_multiple_to_cart with all UPCs in one call, or (2) pass the sessionId returned by your first add_to_cart call into every subsequent add_to_cart call. Always share the latest checkoutUrl with the shopper, not earlier ones.

sessionId.description: Cart/shopping session ID. If you have a sessionId from a prior search_products or add_to_cart call, pass it here so this item joins the same cart AND stays linked to the shopper's searches (powers checkout-page recommendations). Omit only if you have none yet.

found.description: Present and false only when the given sessionId did not exist

sessionId.description: Cart session id — pass into later add_to_cart / get_checkout_url calls

itemCount.description: Total items in the cart after the add

checkoutUrl.description: Latest checkout URL to share with the shopper

message.description: Human-readable note, e.g. when the session was not found

tools.name: add_multiple_to_cart
tools.title: Add Multiple to Cart
tools.description: Add several products to a single Shoppable cart in one call. This is the preferred way to handle a "add A, B, and C to my cart" request — it keeps all items in one cart with one checkout URL, instead of creating separate carts per item. Returns a session ID, a checkout URL, and per-item status (added or skipped with reason).

upcs.description: UPCs to add to a single cart (max 50 items per call)

sessionId.description: Session ID from a prior search_products/add_to_cart call. Pass it so the items join the same session as the shopper's searches (powers checkout-page recommendations). Omit to start a fresh cart.
Cart session id holding all added items

checkoutUrl.description: Single checkout URL for the whole cart

reason.description: Why an item was skipped, when added is false

truncated.description: True if the item list was trimmed to fit the size limit

tools.title: Get Checkout URL
tools.description: Get the checkout URL for an existing cart session.

sessionId.description: Cart session ID returned by add_to_cart or add_multiple_to_cart

checkoutUrl.description: Checkout URL for the cart session

tools.name: get_cart_contents
tools.title: Get Cart Contents
tools.description: Inspect the contents of an existing cart by session ID. Returns the items currently in the cart with names, merchants, prices, and quantities.

sessionId.description: Cart session ID to inspect

found.description: Present and false only when the given sessionId did not exist

sessionId.description: The inspected cart session id

itemCount.description: Total quantity of items in the cart

message.description: Human-readable note, e.g. when the cart was not found

truncated.description: True if the item list was trimmed to fit the size limit

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.title: Remove from Cart
tools.description: Remove a single product (by UPC) from a Shoppable cart. Pass the sessionId of the cart and the UPC of the item to remove — get the UPCs from get_cart_contents. Returns the updated itemCount and checkoutUrl. Removing a UPC that is not in the cart is a harmless no-op. Use this whenever the shopper asks to remove or delete an item; do NOT re-add the remaining items to "reset" the cart (adds only append, so that would not remove anything). Always share the updated checkoutUrl afterward.

upc.description: UPC of the item to remove (get it from get_cart_contents or the search result)

sessionId.description: Cart session ID the item is in (from add_to_cart / get_cart_contents)

found.description: Present and false only when the given sessionId did not exist

sessionId.description: Cart session id

itemCount.description: Total items remaining in the cart after removal

checkoutUrl.description: Updated checkout URL reflecting the removal

message.description: Human-readable note, e.g. when the session was not found

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get Order
tools.description: Look up an order by order number. BEFORE calling this tool, ask the shopper for at least one of: the email address used on the order, the phone number on the order, the billing postal/zip code, or the last name on the order. Pass whatever they confirm as `email`, `phone`, `postalCode`, or `lastName`. The order is only returned if at least one of those matches what is on file; otherwise the response is identical to "order not found" so the existence of the order is not leaked. Never share the order number publicly — treat it as something only the shopper should know. (Legacy: orderId is accepted as an alias for orderNumber for older clients.)

orderNumber.description: Order number the shopper gave you (e.g. "R080346576")

orderId.description: Deprecated alias for orderNumber. Kept for backwards compatibility with older clients; prefer orderNumber.

email.description: Email the shopper used on the order — used to verify they own it

phone.description: Phone number on the order (any format; only the digits matter)

postalCode.description: Billing postal/zip code on the order

lastName.description: Billing last name on the order

found.description: Whether a matching, verified order was returned

needsInput.description: True when more input is required first (an order number, or a verification field). Read `message` and ask the shopper.

order.description: The order, present only when found is true
